Odour control shall achieve not more than 5 OU/m³ at the site boundary, assessed as a 98th percentile hourly value.

missing_information: The numerical odour concentration at the nearest sensitive receptor (ESIA Figure 7-2, data room) is not in the evidence build; insufficient evidence to state the new limit as a number.
items.model_rationale: The pattern drafter's reference wrote 'OU/m3'; the target and the provision print 'OU/m³', so the old string uses m³ (C23 found it once). The trailing words ', assessed as a 98th percentile hourly value' stay, consistent with 'The basis of assessment ... is unchanged.' No crops involved (text-layer units).
